text:
carmen: dropping a micro-proposal for the latency dashboard: add a tiny "view modifier" badge next to the chart title that opens a compact panel with 'Focus (high res)' and a sampling slider. goal: keep scrubber for time range only. quick reads?

jules: love a small badge. suggestion: badge only appears when sampling !=100% or focus is on. clicking it opens a floating panel (no layout shifts).

eli: copy nits: label the slider "Sampling (visual)" and add short subcopy: "Visual-only: smooths plotted points; raw metrics unchanged." show exact percent next to the thumb.

a11y-bot: a11y checklist: badge must be keyboard-openable (press Enter/Space), panel must trap focus while open, preset buttons have aria-pressed, slider exposes aria-valuenow, and any tooltip must be dismissible with ESC. announce changes via aria-live: "Sampling set to X percent."

carmen: UX thought: when sampling or focus is active, dim heatmap to 40% and bring p95 lines and mini-legend above with solid/dashed stroke pairs + a mute toggle for each series. include a small "Revert" link in the badge panel.

jules: interaction: if user picks a preset then tweaks slider, switch preset pill to "Custom" and show a tiny toast: "Sampling set to custom (23%). Click Revert to go back." keep toast short and dismissible.

eli: analytics: event names sampling_panel_opened and sampling_changed with anonymized cohort keys and percent. do NOT log raw metrics.

a11y-bot: keyboard flow to include for eng: 1) Tab to chart title, 2) Enter to open badge panel, 3) Arrow keys to navigate presets, 4) Enter to apply, 5) Tab to slider, 6) Arrow keys to adjust percent (aria-live update), 7) Tab to Revert and press Enter to reset, 8) ESC closes panel. add test cases for screen-reader, high-contrast, and reduced-motion.

carmen: thanks — i'll update mocks with badge/panel, explicit percent labels, dim-on-modifier, solid/dashed strokes, custom state + toast, keyboard flow, and analytics. will post v2 tomorrow morning :sparkles:
